description: A ground-level photograph depicting an agricultural landscape under a partly cloudy sky. In the foreground, a vibrant green field is actively being irrigated by multiple sprinkler heads, visible as several arcs of water across the field. A small building with a dark roof is situated on the left edge of this irrigated field. In the midground, additional fields appear, some green and others brownish-grey, suggesting different stages of cultivation or fallow land. A dirt road is visible on the right side of the midground. The background features a rolling hill covered with scattered trees or scrubland, with at least four distinct electricity transmission towers (power lines) visible against the horizon. This image illustrates an example of irrigated arable land.
